en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a river with a steel railway bridge crossing it. Trees and mountainous terrain are visible in the background, along with calm water and boulders in the river. The caption at the bottom reads 'Erikslund. Jernvägsbron öfver Ljungan.' (Erikslund. Railway bridge over the Ljungan). There is handwriting, a date at the bottom (7/9 1905), and a detailed message on the back, addressed to a person named Selma Melander in Östhammar, with Swedish text. The postal stamp and 'Brefkort' (Swedish for 'postcard') further attest to its origins.
